View Services

In the Customer Portal, click “Services” in the navigation bar.

Click “View Details” on the service you want to review. If the list is empty, there are no active services to select. If the catalog fails to load, try opening it again.
View Service Detail
Customer
Select a service|Open service details|Service available?|Review price and duration|Continue to booking
Show unavailable or missing-service feedback.
Open “Services” and select “View Details” on a service card.
Review the service image, description, price and estimated completion time.

To use the service, sign in as a Customer and continue to your booking. Select the service in the booking flow if it is available. If the service is unavailable, return to the catalog and choose another option.
Configure Services
Admin
Open Service Management|Load service catalog|Choose an operation|Enter fields or confirm removal|Input and access valid?|Save and reload catalog
Show validation, permission or upload error.
Sign in as an Admin and open “Services” from the Admin sidebar. Review the existing service list and status.
Choose to create a new service or open an existing service to edit it. Enter the name, price, description and estimated duration. Upload or replace the service image if needed.
Save the changes and confirm the updated service appears in the list. Correct any required field, pricing, duration or image error before retrying.
To withdraw a service, deactivate it or use the delete action if available. Verify that the updated status is shown in the catalog.
View Ticket Packages
Customer
Open Membership|Load available packages|Catalog loaded?|Filter and compare packages|Select a package
Show an empty catalog or a load error as applicable.
Sign in as a Customer and open the Membership area. Choose the tab that lists packages available for purchase.
Filter by package type when available. Compare price per slot, validity period, slot limit and included service benefits.
Select an eligible package to enter the purchase flow. If a package becomes unavailable or sold out, select another package from the refreshed list.
Purchase Subscription Package
Customer
Select a package|Choose eligible vehicles and slots|Validate selection and limits|Selection eligible?|Confirm Wallet or PayOS payment|Activate slots after payment
Reject invalid selections. A failed or pending payment does not activate an entitlement.
Open the package catalog and choose an active subscription package. Review the price per slot and the package limits.

Choose approved vehicle information and the available subscription parking slots. Keep the selection within the package limit, the number of eligible vehicles and the overall limit of three reserved slots.
Review the selected slots and total price. If a slot has become unavailable, return to the selection and choose another one.
Choose VALO Wallet or PayOS. Verify the amount before confirming. For PayOS, complete the payment and wait for the confirmation to appear.

After confirmation, open “My Membership” and verify the activated entitlements and reserved slots. If payment was received but the entitlements are missing, keep the transaction reference for reconciliation before paying again.
Renew Subscription Package
Customer
Open My Membership|Select an entitlement|Renewal eligible?|Review renewal quote|Pay by Wallet or PayOS|Extend expiry once confirmed
Show eligibility or payment feedback. Pending payment leaves expiry unchanged.
Open “My Membership” and choose the parking entitlement you want to renew. Use the renewal action when it is available.
Review the renewal quote, the current expiry and the proposed expiry. The entitlement must belong to you, remain active, be within the renewal window and be free of a transfer lock.
Choose VALO Wallet or PayOS and confirm the quoted amount. Wait for payment confirmation.
Refresh “My Membership” to verify the new expiry. Confirm the same parking slot remains assigned. If payment is pending, check its status before starting another payment.
Configure Ticket Packages
Admin
Open Ticket Packages|Choose create or edit|Enter settings|Settings and capacity valid?|Save package|Review updated catalog
Reject invalid settings. Deactivate packages with active subscriptions or pending purchases.
In the Admin Portal, open “Ticket Packages” and choose to create a package or edit an existing one.
Enter the package name, type, duration, price and maximum slot allocation. Configure service benefits, sales capacity and renewal conditions as required.
Save and review the updated catalog. If capacity is rejected, check how many slots are already allocated or reserved by pending payments before submitting again.
Deactivate a package to stop new sales when it has active subscriptions or pending transactions. Use the delete action only for an eligible package.
View Digital Contract
Customer
Open own contracts|Select a contract|Check ownership and status|Review saved contract details|Download PDF if eligible
Show not found or access error. Draft contracts cannot be exported to PDF.
Sign in as a Customer and open your digital contracts. Select an available contract by its code or from the list.
Review the contract code, vehicle, parking slot, payment status, validity period and terms.
Use the PDF download action when available. If the contract is still in Draft status, return after it becomes eligible.

If you cannot find a contract, check that it belongs to your account. Digital parking contracts are linked to qualifying monthly or yearly bookings. Subscription purchases and renewals do not automatically create them.

Manage Membership Entitlement
Customer
Open My Membership|Load owned entitlements|Membership data available?|Review slots, benefits and expiry|Open QR, renewal or transfer
Show the unavailable or empty state. Disable actions that are not eligible.
Sign in as a Customer, open Membership and select “My Membership”.
Review your membership status and benefits. Inspect the entitlement cards for assigned floor and slot, current status and expiry.
Select “Show Membership QR” when the action is available and present the QR where required.
Use the renewal or transfer action on an eligible entitlement. Follow the corresponding workflow to complete that action.
Transfer Membership Entitlement
Customer
Choose an owned slot|Choose Direct or Marketplace|Check transfer eligibility|Obtain acceptance and Admin review|Recipient or buyer pays with Wallet|Transfer ownership and show contract
Reject ineligible requests. A failed payment does not change ownership.
Open Membership Transfers and select an active entitlement you own. Check that the slot has no active parking session, maintenance block or open transfer.

Select Direct Transfer and enter the recipient, or choose Marketplace to submit a public listing. Review the remaining value, asking price and the transfer fee of 5% of the calculated remaining value.
For Direct Transfer, the recipient must accept the invitation before Admin review. For Marketplace, wait for Admin review and availability of the listing before an eligible buyer claims it.
The recipient or buyer checks slot eligibility and confirms the payment using VALO Wallet within the applicable window. Confirm the total, including the fee, before paying.
After successful settlement, verify the new owner in Membership and download the transfer contract if available. The parking slot, package and expiry remain the same.

View Parking Map
Admin
Open Parking Lots|Load floor layouts|Floors available?|Render building overview|Select and inspect a floor
If no floors exist, attempt to initialize the default layout. Report load failure separately.
Sign in as an Admin and open “Parking Lots” from the Admin sidebar. Wait for the parking building overview to load.
Choose a floor from the floor selector. Locate the zones, parking slots, gates, roads and facilities in its layout.
Rotate, pan or zoom the 3D map to inspect the area you need. If floor data does not load, refresh the view before relying on it.
View Parking Availability
Admin
Open Parking Lots|Select a floor|Load slots, sessions, bookings and holds|Availability loaded?|Review slot states|Refresh while the map is open
If a data source fails, the map may remain visible with incomplete availability.
Open “Parking Lots” as an Admin and choose a floor. Allow the system to load the slot and session data.
Check the map legend and distinguish Available, Occupied, Reserved, Holding and Maintenance. Review the license plate where the map displays it for an occupied slot.
Keep the map open for automatic updates or change floors to inspect another area. If availability information fails to load, wait for an update or reload the view before acting on it.
View Slot Details
Admin
Open Parking Lots|Select a named slot or zone|Resolve the selected item|Show slot or zone details|Review and close the panel
Show the sync warning if a named layout slot has no database record.
Open “Parking Lots” as an Admin and select the floor containing the slot or zone.

Click a named parking slot to open the details panel. For an occupied slot, review available plate, contact, vehicle and session timing fields. If the slot is reserved, held or under maintenance, review the status shown.
Click a zone to inspect its slot counts and maintenance information.
If a named slot is not synchronized with the database, review the sync warning before using its details for an operational decision. Close the panel when finished.
View Parking Policy
Admin
Open Policy Management|Load policy list|Select a parking policy|Policy found?|Review current, draft and history
Show list or detail error when the requested policy cannot be loaded.
Sign in as an Admin and open “Policy Management” from the Admin sidebar. Locate a parking-related policy such as Parking Rules or Safety Policy.
Select the policy and review its title, slug, category, status, effective date and acceptance requirement.
Review the current published version and any editable draft. Open the version history to inspect previous versions and their status.
If the policy or version no longer exists, return to the list and select an available item.
Design Parking Layout
Admin
Select a floor|Open Edit Layout|Arrange and name zones and slots|Layout valid and removal allowed?|Save and synchronize|Review saved map
Correct duplicate names or invalid positions. Reassign protected slots before removal.
Open “Parking Lots” as an Admin, select the floor and click “Edit Layout”.
Choose elements from the builder sidebar and position them on the canvas. Adjust zones, parking slots, roads, gates and other elements as needed.
Give each zone a unique name. Give each bookable slot a unique name within the floor and position it in a zone. Unnamed slots can remain on the drawing and are excluded from bookable inventory.

Click “Save Map”. If the builder flags an invalid name or slot position, fix it and retry. If removal is blocked because a slot is reserved or occupied, resolve that assignment before removing the slot.
After saving, return to the floor map and verify the updated layout and slot locations.
